effect.name: Deep Glow 2
effect.desc: Multi-pass glow: thresholds the image in linear light, blurs it at three increasing radii with downsampled separable Gaussians, then recombines the layers with exposure, soft-clip knee, tail weighting, tint and Add/Screen/Lighten blending. Includes an optional drop shadow derived from the widest blur's alpha, quality levels, and dither.
